result.title: MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects
result.summary: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 针对透明物体单视角 RGB-D 深度补全，先由先验引导的初始深度构造多范围坐标感知假设体（全局逆深度体与深度轴滤波的逐像素局部体），再用多尺度 ConvGRU 配合越界查找掩码与有效性掩码 softmax 融合做选择性循环细化，最后以逐像素空间门控修正全分辨率残差。
AI.relevance_reason: 「固定采样预算下多范围假设 + 掩码融合 + 循环更新」可供核查 latent 多假设维护、视觉证据筛选与计算预算分配的设计线索，但该文是稠密几何回归任务，与 VLM 推理期 latent 状态无直接关系，迁移性需自行判断。
